name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform for email, funnels, courses, and sales, with a public REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: Only auth option is an API key in the X-API-Key header; keys created in dashboard settings with optional expiry. MCP server uses a separate MCP key (X-MCP-Key header or mcpKey query param).
access_notes: Keys are generated by the account holder under Settings > MCP & API keys. A free plan exists (no credit card). No page states that API access is restricted to paid plans; the pricing page lists an 'API requests per minute' row but values were not extracted, so per-plan rate limits are unverified.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key, documented REST API with about 146 reference pages (llms.txt) across contacts, tags, funnels, courses, payments, webhooks and more; webhooks with secret token. Plan gating not stated, so moderate confidence.

access.quote: generate a new key under the "Public API keys" section
The free plan never expires and does not require a credit card.
